gloss: to imprint; to instill; to rub in

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {刷|す}り{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {刷|す}り{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {刷|す}り{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To deeply embed ideas, beliefs, or behaviors through repeated exposure or conditioning, especially during formative periods.

definitions.gloss: to rub in; to work into
definitions.explanation: To physically rub something into a surface so it penetrates or absorbs.

⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刷|す}り{込|こ}まれた⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刷|す}り{込|こ}む: to instill values
- {刷|す}り{込|こ}まれる: to be conditioned, to be imprinted
- ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{込|こ}む: to rub in cream

WRITING:
- {刷|す}り{込|こ}む (the kanji of printing) is for sense 1: imprinting ideas or, literally, printing a pattern into something. For sense 2, rubbing a substance in, the usual writing is {擦|す}り{込|こ}む or すり{込|こ}む.

RELATED WORDS:
- {刷|す}り{込|こ}み: imprinting, the psychology term for young animals attaching to the first moving thing they see; also, informally, a belief planted by repetition.
